skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic economic principles and their application to household and farm management.
Develop strategic planning and management skills for household and farm operations.
Manage financial resources and risks in household and farm settings.
Manage land resources effectively in household and farm contexts.
Manage labor resources efficiently in household and farm operations.
Develop sales and marketing strategies for agricultural products.
Measure and evaluate the performance of household and farm operations.
Apply critical thinking to solve problems in household and farm management.
Work collaboratively in teams to develop and present management plans.
Demonstrate self-directed learning and responsibility in management decisions.
Develop entrepreneurial skills to start and manage a farm business.
Identify and manage risks in household and farm operations.
Promote sustainable practices in household and farm management.
